title: Unreal Engine Telemetry Event
description: Schema for all telemetry events sent from the TelemetryPlugin.

machine_id.description: Identifier for the machine sending the event (computer name).

session_id.description: Unique identifier for the game session.

user_name.description: The OS username of the player.

event_type.description: The type of event being logged.

frame.description: A sequentially increasing counter for ordering events within a session.

game_time.description: The in-game time in seconds when the event occurred.

run_data.description: Contextual data about the current gameplay run.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific gameplay run.

run_start_time.description: Game time in seconds when the run began.

run_end_time.description: Game time in seconds when the run ended. 0 if the run is still active.

run_total_time.description: Total duration of the run in seconds. 0 if the run is still active.

end_reason.description: The reason the run concluded (e.g., 'death', 'victory', 'quit'). Empty if active.

health_before.description: Player's health before the damage was applied.

health_after.description: Player's health after the damage was applied.

cause.description: The cause of the player's death (e.g., 'enemy', 'fall_damage').

position.description: Represents a 3D coordinate in the game world.
